title: project
description: Result of `stride project <YYYY-MM-DD> ["<date>=<target>,..."]` (ADR 0010, ADR 0019, ADR 0022): CTL/ATL/TSB on the target date, folded by the same recurrence daily_load runs — over the RECORDED open plan (plan_source: recorded), or over a caller-passed hypothetical plan that REPLACES it in the walk (plan_source: hypothetical). Every target kind is priced on its own rung: power as TSS against the ride FTP, pace as rTSS against its family's threshold speed, a heart-rate band or zone as hrTSS, a session rating as session-RPE load. A session its target cannot price is listed in unprojected with its reason. Over the recorded plan every day no target prices is filled from the athlete's own history and says so: a session by its estimate, a day with no session at the recent daily mean (series[].load_source, load_sources). A hypothetical plan is taken as written. The hypothetical is echoed back (dates as given, targets in canonical form, so 1x60:00@Z2 echoes as 1x1:00:00@Z2) and never stored — the recorded plan stays the single source of adherence truth. stride never solves for the plan that reaches a target: plan to consequences only.

unprojected.description: Each session in the window whose target adds no load of its own, with why: no_target (no structured target), no_ftp (a power target with no ride FTP on file), no_hr_zones (a heart-rate band with no zones configured), no_threshold_pace (a pace target whose sport families have no 60-day threshold on file, or whose intensity against the nearest one exceeds the 1.5 bound analyze enforces). sessions_considered minus sessions_projected counts them. Over the recorded plan each is estimated from the athlete's history unless it is typed rest; its day's load_source says which.

target_literal.description: The session's target in canonical form; empty when it has none.

hypothetical.description: The caller's plan, echoed back with dates as given and each target in canonical form (1x60:00@Z2 echoes as 1x1:00:00@Z2); empty for plan_source: recorded.

dur_s.description: Seconds per rep; 0 for a distance rep.

watts.description: Target watts; 0 for every kind but power.

series.description: The projection day by day: one row per day from the day after projected_from through target_date, from the same walk that gives ctl, atl and tsb, so the row on target_date carries those values (ADR 0022: the series runs to target_date even past the plan's last day, where it once stopped on that day). Empty when target_date is not after projected_from. load is the day's load and load_source where it came from. load_known is false when a session on the day has nothing to estimate from (ADR 0022: an unpriced session that carries an estimate no longer makes it false); load then counts only the sessions that carried a load, and load_source names the least certain of their sources, or none, with load 0, when no session on the day carried one. A recorded plan holds one session a day, so a mixed day occurs only in a hypothetical plan that names a date twice.

load_sources.description: The projected days counted by where their load came from (ADR 0022), the sources series[].load_source names: target (priced by its target), estimate (a session no target prices, estimated from the athlete's own history), habit (a day with no open session, at the mean daily load of the 28 days ending on projected_from), rest (a session typed rest, or in a hypothetical plan a day it does not name), none (no session on the day carried a load: the history an estimate needs is missing, or a hypothetical target cannot be priced). They sum to the number of projected days.

forecast_check.description: How close the projection's forecast of the recorded plan has been (ADR 0022). For each of the last `weeks` weeks the engine is given only what it knew at the end of that week's Sunday: the recorded days through it, the sessions scored through it, and the plan as it then stood (every planned session written by that day for a later day, done and skipped ones included, the latest of a day written twice). It projects forward with the walk `project` runs, the estimate's settings and today's inputs included, and compares the state on the day `days_out` ahead with what daily_load recorded there. Errors are forecast minus recorded: _mae the mean of their sizes, _bias their mean, _max the largest size. A distance the record cannot check for every week is known: false, with weeks_checked saying how many it could and every error 0.

weeks.description: The weeks each distance ahead is checked over.

horizons.description: One entry per distance ahead: 7, 14 and 28 days.
